items.markdown:
Top things to do in Koh Samui include visiting the [Big Buddha Temple (Wat Phra Yai)](https://www.viator.com/Koh-Samui/d347) , exploring Ang Thong National Marine Park , and relaxing at Chaweng Beach . This stunning Thai island offers a mix of rich culture, beautiful nature, and fun coastal activities.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g293918-Activities-Ko_Samui_Surat_Thani_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g293918-Activities-Ko_Samui_Surat_Thani_Province.html)[[2]](https://northabroad.com/an-extensive-travel-guide-to-koh-samui/)[[3]](https://www.expedia.co.uk/Things-To-Do-In-Koh-Samui-Islands.d3657.Travel-Guide-Activities)[[4]](https://www.viator.com/en-GB/Koh-Samui/d347)[[5]](https://www.roamwhere.com/blog/ultimate-travel-guide-to-koh-samui-thailand)

Cultural Landmarks and Sights

- **Big Buddha (Wat Phra Yai):** See the famous 12-meter-tall golden Buddha statue located on a small rocky island.
- **Wat Plai Laem:** Visit this colorful temple complex featuring a striking 18-armed statue of the goddess Guanyin set on a peaceful lake.
- **Hin Ta and Hin Yai Rocks:** View the unique rock formations on Lamai Beach known locally as the Grandfather and Grandmother rocks.[](https://whatkirstydidnext.com/travel/top-things-to-do-in-koh-samui/) [[1]](https://whatkirstydidnext.com/travel/top-things-to-do-in-koh-samui/)[[2]](https://northabroad.com/an-extensive-travel-guide-to-koh-samui/)[[3]](https://www.22places.com/koh-samui-things-to-do/)[[4]](https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/ko-samui-l898/)

Nature and Outdoor Adventures

- **Ang Thong National Marine Park:** Take a boat trip to this nearby group of 42 islands for kayaking, hiking, and stunning blue lagoons.
- **Na Muang Waterfalls:** Hike through the green jungle to see two scenic cascading waterfalls where you can cool off in natural pools.
- **Overlap Stone:** Climb up to this high viewpoint in the hills to get a sweeping look at the ocean and green tree tops.[](https://zannavandijk.co.uk/ae12-things-to-do-in-koh-samui-thailand/) [[1]](https://zannavandijk.co.uk/ae12-things-to-do-in-koh-samui-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.expedia.co.uk/Things-To-Do-In-Koh-Samui-Islands.d3657.Travel-Guide-Activities)[[3]](https://elephantjunglesanctuary.com/blog/best-things-to-do-in-koh-samui/)

Food and Local Culture

- **Fisherman’s Village in Bophut:** Stroll down the charming pedestrian street filled with boutique shops, beachside restaurants, and a lively night market on Fridays.
- **Thai Cooking Class:** Learn how to make local dishes like Pad Thai and green curry from scratch with a guided family recipe class.
- **Ethical Elephant Sanctuaries:** Spend time feeding and walking alongside rescued elephants in protected, natural jungle environments.[](https://whatkirstydidnext.com/travel/top-things-to-do-in-koh-samui/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HDst-onsUVs&t=126)
